summary: Phase 4 passes at 2bfbd373f. The three heavy-run gates pass: coverage (98 files, 1494 tests, 92.08 % lines), check-types and lint (0 errors, 1 warning). The report numbers, the K table and the late-finding records match the logs and git. No K row was deleted and no production code changed. Review A at HEAD and the Phase 1 adversarial pass at the equal apps tree meet the path rule, so no Phase 4 adversarial result is needed. Five nonblocking documentation items stay open.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: classification.md:267 still says 'The second lever is the primary-advantage content pin set (102 D5 cases); its replacement design decides the final count.' The D5 revert removed that lever. Plan task 4.18 says ADV-P1-10 fixed the projection note. ADV-P1-10 named this sentence, and the added note sits in the Projected cut section above it. Review A N14 and Phase 1 acceptance N2 report the same item. Fix: mark the sentence as superseded by the D5 revert of 2026-11-25, or delete it.

N2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: report.md:14 says 'Without the blog merge, the suite holds 3203 cases'. HEAD holds 121 posts (62 en and 59 th). The unmerged file would hold 14 x 121 + 2 + 59 = 1755 cases, so the suite would hold about 3232 cases. The sentence defines 3203 as 1494 plus 1709, and the conclusion holds: there is no net cut without the merge. Same item as Review A N13. Fix: write 'the final 1494 plus the 1709 cases the blog merge removed at task 3.5'.

N3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: three items of phase-acceptance-d2c8e63.json stay open. F52: report.md:72 says 'No commit and no gate' for D3, but the table row names 409108d3e (a plan commit). F53: report.md:78 says 'the phase-base test' with no SHA; the intended base is 8a126f612. F54: report.md:203 cites the gate-66aeb1011.json green command for the wait variable HEAVY_PREFLIGHT_WAIT_S=3600. F55 is fixed. final-acceptance-dc9d39d.json N6 lists F52 to F55 as known open items by PM decision.

N4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan tasks 4.13, 4.15 and 4.18 say the heavy-run gates passed. They name no check-types or lint log, and task 4.15 names no log for e993f5aa1. The claims hold: ~/.local/state/heavy-run.log shows exit 0 jobs for the suite, coverage, check-types and lint from 2026-11-25 00:25 to 00:31, before f97a72f90. My fresh run passes the same three gates at HEAD. Fix: cite the log paths, or accept the gap.

N5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md:789-790 record the work of documents commits ecff7cfad, 7336f42b3 and 2bfbd373f under task 4.18. The SHA of task 4.18 is f97a72f90. Neither line names those three commits. This gives a traceability gap only. No claim is false.
evidence: The audited HEAD and the role base are 2bfbd373fef2fc500798efe721975fa0a345e73f. The Phase 4 base is e91c4d4cc3c8d5d61a1e9b802c031247543180fa, from phase-acceptance-d2c8e63.json. git status is clean outside measure/runs before and after the gates. No remote branch holds HEAD.

Prerequisites: test-strategy.md section 2 (row P4) and section 10 require Review A only for Phase 4, with no adversarial pass and no browser review. review-a-2bfbd37.json targets this exact HEAD and passes with no blocker.

Path rule decision: no Phase 4 adversarial result is needed at the current apps tree, so I raise no finding for it. adversarial-dc9d39d.json predates the D5 revert. dc9d39dac to HEAD changes 12 test files (f97a72f90) plus documents, so the test-only exception does not extend that result. It is not a prerequisite.

Path rule, Phase 1 adversarial: adversarial-p1-7336f42.json passes at 7336f42b3. git rev-parse gives the same apps tree, 5580899cc, at 7336f42b3 and at HEAD. The delta 7336f42b3 to HEAD is classification.md, plan.md and report.md only. phase-acceptance-p1-2bfbd37.json passes at HEAD.

Fresh mutants, run in memory against the HEAD apps tree (phase-acceptance-p4-2bfbd37-mutate.mjs): the control passes 4 files and 89 cases. The S7 floor at 2,400 baht in en and th fails 5 cases. The S9 answer 2 'by invoice' fails 3 cases. The Thai tutorRole.points.3 'guarantee' text fails 1 case ('holds the new th copy at both paths'). git status shows no file change.

Heavy-run coverage at HEAD: heavy-run log line 'job ended exit 0 after 150 s'. Vitest passed 98 files and 1494 tests. Lines 92.08 % (1675 of 1819), statements 90.95 %, branches 82.99 %, functions 87.52 %. The floor is 85.52 %. The shell tool printed no Exit code line and no ELIFECYCLE line.

Heavy-run check-types at HEAD: heavy-run log line 'job ended exit 0 after 4 s'. The output is 'tsc --noEmit' with no diagnostic. Heavy-run lint at HEAD: 'job ended exit 0 after 5 s'. ESLint reports 0 errors and 1 warning, 'beforeEach' unused at www-reading-card.red.test.ts:3.
The coverage run prints 122 'Failed to parse ... .md. Excluding it from coverage' lines. coverage-at-f97a72f9.log holds the same 122 lines, so they are known noise and not a regression.

Tasks 4.1 to 4.18 all use [x] (probe G1). Each first-line SHA resolves to a commit in e91c4d4cc..HEAD. Each full-SHA Commit line matches its first-line SHA. The report wording commit 9ccdeac32 of task 4.15 resolves. A4: the phase holds 18 [x] tasks, so the marker check is not vacuous.

Report numbers (probe G2): baseline.json gives case_count 3175 and line_coverage_pct 86.52. The final run gives 1494 tests in 98 files and 92.08 %. The cut is 1681 cases (52.945 %, shown as 52.9 %). The target is 635. The coverage rise is 5.56 points.

Blog merge: gate-257a6b0c.json gives cases_before 3094 and cases_after 1385, so the merge removed 1709 cases. 1494 + 1709 = 3203, and 3203 - 3175 = 28. proof-blog-merge.log ends with 1 failed and 16 passed of 17 under one mutated post.

K table (probe G4): classification.md holds 77 K file rows that sum to 2843. The report K table equals them in path, count and order. The D5 section holds 14 files and 221 cases. 2843 + 221 = 3064 and 3064 / 3175 = 96.5 %. 3064 + 67 + 22 + 0 + 6 + 0 + 16 = 3175.

Section 2 per-class table (probe G3): all 11 class rows resolve to commits and name existing logs. Each row with a gate JSON equals that file in cases_before, cases_after, green_exit_code and coverage. All 23 fix-commit rows resolve and each GREEN and COVERAGE log ends with its summary line.

Criteria (b) and (c): all 30 gate JSON files show status pass, green_exit_code 0, coverage_exit_code 0 and line coverage at or above 85.52. coverage-at-ca91946b.log, coverage-at-f97a72f9.log and coverage-257a6b0c.log are 92.08, 92.08 and 91.6. green-at-ca91946b.log holds 1414 tests and green-merge-e836e7289.log holds 1413.

One commit per class (probe G6): 0be4a0374 (D1), e332f594e (D2), 0d705612d (D4), ee5c7b739, 7008ccefd, c577cdf18 and 407c5d9bd (D5 parts), adf24e723 (R2) and 257a6b0cd (blog merge) each change only www test paths that match their class rows. 409108d3e is a plan commit with no test change.

D5 revert f97a72f90 changes 12 test files, all changed by the four D5 parts, and no non-test file. 8 of 12 equal the pre-D5 tree 5a104ba6d. 4 differ only by named non-D5 commits: master 968bde612 and merge 6ee56327b, 4d1688131, fb5622ed7 and 733319505. No restored file imports the locale-key helper.

No K row deleted (probe G4): all 77 K files and 14 D5 files exist at HEAD. The seven tutor-commission files are unchanged from a1caa5803 to HEAD (git diff output empty). Every lost static case title maps to a D1, D2 or D4 row of its own file. The two approved exceptions are the blog merge and one stricter Storytime scanner control.

Deleted files since the track base are primary-advantage/page.test.tsx (D2 row) and layout-components.test.ts (D1 row). Neither holds a K row. HEAD holds 1494 cases against a lower bound of 1431 (K 3064 - 1709 + 60 D1 rewrites + 16 R2 rewrites).

No production code changed (probe G5): git diff --name-only 635a604c89 HEAD outside measure/ lists 57 paths. 52 are test or fixture paths. 5 are two blog images, two new blog posts and home.ts. Those 5 equal master 968bde612 content. HEAD differs from master only in 51 test and fixture paths.

No track-only non-merge commit (110 of them) touches a non-test path outside measure/. The master merge 6ee56327b resolves by hand only three test and fixture files. git diff --check over e91c4d4cc..HEAD exits 0.

Late findings (probe G7): plan.md holds 10 lines in the contract form 'Late finding <id>: tech-debt (<reason>)' under the Phase 4 heading: L1, ADV-26 to ADV-32, ADV-P1-9 and N8. One Open, Low row of measure/tech-debt.md names all ten ids. tech-debt.md holds 50 lines.

A5: the plan holds no 'PASS=N', 'FAIL=0' or 'all checks pass' claim. Task 4.2 (90.47s and 98.11s), task 4.3 (1763 = 3175 - 1412), task 4.13 and 4.15 (1413 tests), task 4.17 (1414 tests, cut 1761) and task 4.18 (1494 tests, cut 1681, one lint warning) match their logs or my fresh gates.

A3, A4, A6 and A7 do not apply: the Phase 4 range changes no contract test, filter or tracks registry. tracks.md says 'new, opened 2026-11-22; Phase 1 next' and makes no resolved claim. Closeout rewrites that line. A9: no row cites measure/archive. A15: no new sha256, checksum or md5 field. Every track-only commit subject names the track id.
Phase checker: head 2bfbd373f, worktree clean. www_test_audit_pilot_20261122 has no incomplete phase and appears as closeout candidate C10.

Not audited again: removed finding history, run-file counts, F17, F18, F11 and the doctor.sh exit (final-acceptance-dc9d39d.json N1). The probes compare static case titles, which do not prove runner case identity.
